policies.title: Public ownership of water
policies.statement: Bring water companies into public ownership to end privatisation failures and stop sewage being dumped into rivers and seas.

policies.title: A wealth tax on the very richest
policies.statement: Introduce an annual wealth tax on assets over £10 million to fund public services and reduce inequality.

policies.title: Rent controls and a rent freeze
policies.statement: Freeze rents for a year and introduce permanent rent controls, alongside stronger rights for renters against unfair eviction.

policies.title: Proportional representation and workers' rights
policies.statement: Introduce proportional representation for all UK elections and a Workers' Charter guaranteeing stronger rights from day one of employment.

policies.title: Rapid shift to renewable energy
policies.statement: Accelerate the switch to renewable energy and fund large-scale nature restoration, including rewilding and river restoration.

policies.title: Cheaper, greener transport
policies.statement: Increase funding for buses and cut speed limits on motorways to 55mph to reduce transport costs and emissions.
